newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR Corp land seen selling for about 45 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: JNR Corp land seen selling for about 45 bln yen.

text.p: A prime tract of land in Tokyo to be auctioned by JNR Settlement Corp on Thursday afternoon is likely to sell for about 45 billion yen, analysts said.
"If it's around 45 billion yen then it's a solid sale. The question is whether or not it fetches more than 45 billion," said an analyst at one research institute.
The 4,835 sq metres of land is located outside Tokyo railway station. Auction results will be announced at 5 p.m. (0800 GMT).
But some analysts said the price could go higher because Yodobashi Camera, an unlisted firm, paid a premium for land in a JNR Settlement auction in Osaka earlier this week.
The consumer goods discounter said at the time it was eager to expand into western Japan.
"If we get firms like Yodobashi that are really desperate for the land, then the auction price could jump," said an analyst at a foreign brokerage.
JNR Settlement said 11 groups were bidding for the land.
